facts.fact: Midi Madagasikara, interviewing a digital-law specialist, describes the cybercrime law as a bill (projet de loi) that would raise penalties, require suspicious-transaction reports on Mobile Money transfers of 10 million ariary or more and tighten SIM identification; no law is described as in force. The article gives no event date, so its published date of 2026-09-12 is used.
